Add a Pause live updates control to the memo feed. Pausing must keep the rendered feed in place, close the active WebSocket, remove its listeners, cancel any pending reconnect, set the accessible connection status to "paused", and ignore late events from every released socket. Resuming must create exactly one fresh socket and continue accepting only newer message versions. Preserve the existing application shell, deterministic fake WebSocket API, reconnect behavior, feed identity, static About route, and build command. Do not add a dependency or replace the fake transport. Run npm run build before finishing.
